strongest_angle: In October 2026, veteran Washington Post columnist Michelle Singletary launched her new video podcast Dollars & Sense, tackling heavy financial burdens like $100,000 in student loan debt and highlighting reports that debt payments are growing eight times faster than take-home pay.

key_facts.fact: In October 2026, personal finance columnist Michelle Singletary launched her new video podcast Dollars & Sense with The Washington Post.
Michelle Singletary's October 2026 podcast launch featured a family tackling $100,000 in student loan debt and nearly $92,000 in Parent PLUS loans.
An October 2026 report highlighted by Michelle Singletary in The Washington Post showed that debt payments are growing eight times faster than take-home pay.
In October 2026, CNBC published an interview with Michelle Singletary detailing her debt and money advice.

quotes.text: Longtime money columnist on the advice everyone needs to hear: 'If debt was a person I would slap it'
quotes.speaker: Michelle Singletary
